Summarize a run trace

Usage:
  paw stats [task-id] [flags]

Examples:
  paw stats task-abc123
  paw stats --trace-file .paw/trace-task-abc123.ndjson
  paw stats task-abc123 --rate brain:in=3.0,brain:out=15.0,drone=0.25

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for stats
      --rate string   token rates per 1M tokens, comma-separated

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --log-format string   log format: text, json (default "text")
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output
